title: 6 Signs a Godly Man Doesn't Have a Sunday Version of Himself
caption:
6 signs a godly man doesn't have a Sunday version of himself.

How he talks about his boss when his boss isn't in the room. What his search history says next to what his testimony says. What he actually did at 11 PM compared to what he posted at 11 AM. None of it is complicated. It's just whether the man people don't see is the same one they do.

A double-minded man is unstable in everything he does (James 1:8). Not cursed, not hopeless, just split. And a split man can't be trusted with much until he isn't split anymore.

Start with one room. Let it match the rest.
